_comment: Review screenshot sweep (Tools/screenshot_sweep.ps1) for the gate-1 law-firm floor. Positions are PLAN space in cm (photo x right, y down toward the window; see Docs/FLOORPLAN-SCHEMA.md); yaw_plan 0 = facing +x, 90 = facing +y (toward the window). The script converts to Unreal (X = plan.y, Y = -plan.x, yaw = plan yaw - 90) and launches the packaged exe with ?spawn=X,Y,0,Yaw. Floor is z = 0 everywhere in Gate 1.
